note: Hackathons from Y Combinator's own events site, read from the Inertia props its pages ship. Same candidate shape as the Luma sweep; merged and scored by scripts/normalize-events.mjs.

candidates.title: The Fast Hackathon: Build the Future of Software Engineering
candidates.evidence:
Hosted By
Greptile
The Fast Hackathon
Sunday, August 23
San Francisco, CA
Capacity 150
About Event
Greptile is hosting its second Fast Hackathon at YC in San Francisco on Sunday, August 23rd. 

Prizes include a YC interview, 2 round-trip tickets anywhere in the world, Apple Vision Pros, Nintendo Switch 2, tons of credits & swag. 

Build the next generation of developer tools, from AI coding agents and IDEs to testing, infrastructure, security, deployment, and everything in between. If it helps developers build better software, we want to see it. 

Lunch & boba will be provided. See you there! 

Requirements: All teams must use OpenAI Codex as their primary coding agent. Other development tools are welcome, but Codex must play a meaningful role in building your project to be eligible for judging and prizes. 

When: Sunday August 23rd 12pm-6pm 

 12 pm doors open 
 12:30 pm opening remarks from Greptile
 1 pm hackathon begins 
 5 pm hacking ends 
 5 pm - 5:45 pm judging 
 6 pm prizes + closing remarks

Who Should Apply: We're looking for exceptional engineers who love building developer tools, AI products, and ambitious side projects. If that sounds like you, we'd love to see what you can build. 

Teams are encouraged; max team size of 4

Why Join: 

Build something interesting that people will actually use 

Meet like-minded individuals and grow your community 

Connect with the team members at Greptile, Stripe, AWS, Modal & DoorDash 

Perks for Builders: 

 100 Greptile Credits 
 Stripe $500 credit link for all participants 
 OpenAI $50 credit link for all participants 
 Swag 

Sponsors: 

 Stripe 
 AWS 
 OpenAI 
 Modal 
 DoorDash
